title: SOC 2: what an organization shows for each criterion, in our own words (shaped like the points of focus, which were not read)

controls.title: Integrity and ethics, matter 1
controls.statement: A written code of conduct or set of values exists, and people acknowledge it.

controls.title: Integrity and ethics, matter 2
controls.statement: Departures from the values are noticed and dealt with, and leadership is seen to apply the same rules to itself.

controls.title: Independent oversight, matter 1
controls.statement: The oversight body has members who are free of day-to-day management and has stated what it oversees.

controls.title: Independent oversight, matter 2
controls.statement: The oversight body meets, reviews the state of internal control and records what it asked for.

controls.title: Structure and authority, matter 1
controls.statement: Reporting lines, roles and authority for security are written down and kept current.

controls.title: Structure and authority, matter 2
controls.statement: Each security objective and control has a named owner who knows they own it.

controls.title: Competent people, matter 1
controls.statement: Roles state the skills they need, and hiring and training follow that.

controls.title: Competent people, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization plans for succession and for the skills it will need next.

controls.title: Accountability, matter 1
controls.statement: Performance of staff is judged against their part in control, with consequences when they fall short.

controls.title: Accountability, matter 2
controls.statement: Pressure to meet targets is balanced so that it does not reward cutting corners.

controls.title: Useful information, matter 1
controls.statement: The organization knows which information its controls depend on and checks that it is complete and right.

controls.title: Useful information, matter 2
controls.statement: Information is made available to the people who run controls when they need it.

controls.title: Internal communication, matter 1
controls.statement: Staff are told the policies and their duties, and can ask questions and raise concerns without penalty.

controls.title: Internal communication, matter 2
controls.statement: Changes to responsibilities and to the system are communicated to those affected.

controls.title: External communication, matter 1
controls.statement: Customers and partners are told what the organization commits to, and how to report problems or incidents.

controls.title: External communication, matter 2
controls.statement: Messages from outside are collected and reach the people who must act on them.

controls.title: Clear objectives, matter 1
controls.statement: Objectives are written, measurable where possible and tied to the risks they imply.

controls.title: Clear objectives, matter 2
controls.statement: Objectives are reviewed when the business or its environment changes.

controls.title: Risk identification, matter 1
controls.statement: A risk assessment is done at a stated interval across the whole entity, with owners for each risk.

controls.title: Risk identification, matter 2
controls.statement: Each risk has a decision on how it is handled and the decision is recorded.

controls.title: Fraud risk, matter 1
controls.statement: Ways in which fraud, abuse or misuse could occur are considered in the risk assessment.

controls.title: Fraud risk, matter 2
controls.statement: Incentives, pressures and opportunities that could lead to fraud are looked at.

controls.title: Change and risk, matter 1
controls.statement: Changes in the business, the technology, the law and the leadership are watched for their effect on risk.

controls.title: Change and risk, matter 2
controls.statement: The risk assessment is revisited when such a change happens.

controls.title: Evaluating controls, matter 1
controls.statement: Controls are tested on a plan, by people who do not run them where that is practical.

controls.title: Evaluating controls, matter 2
controls.statement: The scope and frequency of the testing follow the risk of what is tested.

controls.title: Reporting deficiencies, matter 1
controls.statement: Deficiencies are logged with an owner and a date.

controls.title: Reporting deficiencies, matter 2
controls.statement: Leadership and the oversight body are told of the serious ones, and the fixes are followed to the end.

controls.title: Control activities, matter 1
controls.statement: Controls are chosen to bring each assessed risk to an accepted level, and the choice is traceable.

controls.title: Control activities, matter 2
controls.statement: Separation of duties is considered in how controls are built.

controls.title: Technology controls, matter 1
controls.statement: The technology the controls rely on is identified and its general controls are chosen.

controls.title: Technology controls, matter 2
controls.statement: Controls over access, change and operation of technology are in place and automated where sensible.

controls.title: Policies and procedures, matter 1
controls.statement: Policies exist for the areas of risk, are approved and are reviewed on a schedule.

controls.title: Policies and procedures, matter 2
controls.statement: Procedures say who does what, and the people who run them have the competence and the time.

controls.title: Logical access protection, matter 1
controls.statement: Systems and data that matter are inventoried, and access to each is controlled by an enforced rule.

controls.title: Logical access protection, matter 2
controls.statement: Authentication is required, and the strength of it is set by what is protected.

controls.title: Access provisioning, matter 1
controls.statement: A new user is registered and authorized by someone who may do so before access is given.

controls.title: Access provisioning, matter 2
controls.statement: Access is reviewed and removed when a person leaves, changes role or no longer needs it.

controls.title: Least privilege, matter 1
controls.statement: Access is given by role with the least needed, and sensitive duties are split between people.

controls.title: Least privilege, matter 2
controls.statement: Changes to access are approved, recorded and periodically reviewed.

controls.title: Physical access, matter 1
controls.statement: Access to the places that hold systems and data is limited to those authorized and the access is logged.

controls.title: Physical access, matter 2
controls.statement: Visitors and physical access rights are managed and reviewed.

controls.title: Retiring assets, matter 1
controls.statement: Assets that held data are wiped or destroyed so the data cannot be read, and this is recorded.

controls.title: Retiring assets, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization knows when an asset is retired and who handled it.

controls.title: Outside threats, matter 1
controls.statement: The system's boundary is protected against threats from outside, with controls on what may enter and leave.

controls.title: Outside threats, matter 2
controls.statement: Remote and external access is limited, authenticated and monitored.

controls.title: Information in motion, matter 1
controls.statement: Information moved, sent or received is protected, for example by encryption in transit.

controls.title: Information in motion, matter 2
controls.statement: Who may move data out, and by which means, is restricted and checked.

controls.title: Malicious software, matter 1
controls.statement: Software and devices are protected against malicious code, and the protection is kept current.

controls.title: Malicious software, matter 2
controls.statement: Unauthorized or unapproved software is prevented or noticed.

controls.title: Detecting weaknesses, matter 1
controls.statement: Configurations are baselined and changes against the baseline are detected.

controls.title: Detecting weaknesses, matter 2
controls.statement: Vulnerabilities are scanned for on a schedule and the results are acted on by risk.

controls.title: Monitoring for anomalies, matter 1
controls.statement: Systems and networks are monitored for unusual activity, with logs kept and reviewed.

controls.title: Monitoring for anomalies, matter 2
controls.statement: Alerts reach a person who is expected to look at them and who records what they decided.

controls.title: Judging events, matter 1
controls.statement: Events are judged against a stated test of what counts as an incident, and the judgement is recorded.

controls.title: Judging events, matter 2
controls.statement: The people who judge events have the information and the authority to do so.

controls.title: Incident response, matter 1
controls.statement: An incident response plan names roles, steps and contacts, and is tested.

controls.title: Incident response, matter 2
controls.statement: Incidents are contained, remedied and communicated, and what was learnt changes the controls.

controls.title: Recovery from incidents, matter 1
controls.statement: Plans exist to recover from incidents and are exercised.

controls.title: Recovery from incidents, matter 2
controls.statement: After an incident the organization restores service and records what changed.

controls.title: Change management, matter 1
controls.statement: Changes are requested, assessed, approved, tested and recorded before they reach production.

controls.title: Change management, matter 2
controls.statement: Emergency changes follow a defined path and are reviewed afterwards.

controls.title: Business disruption, matter 1
controls.statement: The organization has assessed which business disruptions matter and how each would be handled.

controls.title: Business disruption, matter 2
controls.statement: Insurance or other means of transferring risk are considered where they fit.

controls.title: Vendors and partners, matter 1
controls.statement: Vendors and partners are assessed for risk before they are used and on a schedule after.

controls.title: Vendors and partners, matter 2
controls.statement: Obligations of vendors are in contract and their performance and reports are reviewed.

controls.title: Capacity, matter 1
controls.statement: Capacity of the systems is watched and compared with what demand is expected to be.

controls.title: Capacity, matter 2
controls.statement: Capacity is added or reduced before a shortfall causes a failure.

controls.title: Protection of availability, matter 1
controls.statement: Protections against environmental threats, power and similar loss are in place and maintained.

controls.title: Protection of availability, matter 2
controls.statement: Backups and the means to recover are made on a schedule and kept safe.

controls.title: Testing recovery, matter 1
controls.statement: Recovery plans are tested on a schedule and the results are recorded.

controls.title: Testing recovery, matter 2
controls.statement: Gaps found in a test are fixed and the plan is changed.

controls.title: Confidential information, matter 1
controls.statement: Confidential information is identified and kept apart from other information.

controls.title: Confidential information, matter 2
controls.statement: Access to it and its protection in storage and transit follow its confidentiality needs.

controls.title: Disposing of confidential information, matter 1
controls.statement: Confidential information is deleted or destroyed at the end of its need, with proof that it was.

controls.title: Disposing of confidential information, matter 2
controls.statement: Requests to destroy it are tracked to completion.

controls.title: Processing specifications, matter 1
controls.statement: The organization states what the processing is meant to do and what makes its output correct.

controls.title: Processing specifications, matter 2
controls.statement: Definitions of the data and of the outputs are kept current.

controls.title: Input checks, matter 1
controls.statement: Inputs are checked for completeness and validity as they arrive.

controls.title: Input checks, matter 2
controls.statement: Rejected inputs are logged and dealt with.

controls.title: Processing checks, matter 1
controls.statement: Processing is checked to make sure it is complete, accurate and on time.

controls.title: Processing checks, matter 2
controls.statement: Errors in processing are found and corrected, and the cause is looked at.

controls.title: Output checks, matter 1
controls.statement: Outputs are checked to be complete and right before they are released.

controls.title: Output checks, matter 2
controls.statement: Outputs go only to those intended.

controls.title: Stored data checks, matter 1
controls.statement: Stored data is protected from change and loss, and is checked to be whole.

controls.title: Stored data checks, matter 2
controls.statement: Changes to stored data leave a record.

controls.title: Privacy notice, matter 1
controls.statement: A notice of privacy practices is given to the people whose information is held.

controls.title: Privacy notice, matter 2
controls.statement: The notice is kept current and tells people what is collected, why, and who gets it.

controls.title: Choice and consent, matter 1
controls.statement: People are given choices about the collection and use of their information, and their consent is recorded where it is needed.

controls.title: Choice and consent, matter 2
controls.statement: A person's choice is honoured in later use.

controls.title: Limited collection, matter 1
controls.statement: Only the personal information the stated purposes need is collected.

controls.title: Limited collection, matter 2
controls.statement: The sources and methods of collection are known.

controls.title: Explicit consent for sensitive data, matter 1
controls.statement: Sensitive information is collected only with the person's explicit consent.

controls.title: Explicit consent for sensitive data, matter 2
controls.statement: The consent is recorded and can be withdrawn.

controls.title: Limited use, matter 1
controls.statement: Personal information is used only for the purposes stated.

controls.title: Limited use, matter 2
controls.statement: A new use is checked against the notice and the consent first.

controls.title: Retention, matter 1
controls.statement: Personal information is kept no longer than its purposes and the law need.

controls.title: Retention, matter 2
controls.statement: Retention periods are set and applied.

controls.title: Disposal of personal information, matter 1
controls.statement: Personal information is disposed of securely at the end of its retention.

controls.title: Disposal of personal information, matter 2
controls.statement: Disposal is recorded.

controls.title: Access by the person, matter 1
controls.statement: People can ask for the personal information held about them and can have it.

controls.title: Access by the person, matter 2
controls.statement: Requests are authenticated, answered in time, and refusals are explained.

controls.title: Correction, matter 1
controls.statement: People can ask to correct or update their information, and the changes are made.

controls.title: Correction, matter 2
controls.statement: Those who got the information before are told where the correction matters.

controls.title: Disclosure with consent, matter 1
controls.statement: Information is disclosed to third parties only where the person has agreed or the law requires it.

controls.title: Disclosure with consent, matter 2
controls.statement: The purposes of the disclosure match what the person was told.

controls.title: Record of authorized disclosures, matter 1
controls.statement: Authorized disclosures are recorded.

controls.title: Record of authorized disclosures, matter 2
controls.statement: The record is kept for as long as it is needed to answer a request.

controls.title: Record of unauthorized disclosures, matter 1
controls.statement: Disclosures that were not authorized are recorded and followed up.

controls.title: Record of unauthorized disclosures, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization learns from them.

controls.title: Third parties' obligations, matter 1
controls.statement: Third parties who get personal information agree in writing to protect it as the organization has promised.

controls.title: Third parties' obligations, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization checks that they do.

controls.title: Third parties report incidents, matter 1
controls.statement: Third parties must tell the organization of incidents that touch the information it gave them.

controls.title: Third parties report incidents, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization acts on such reports.

controls.title: Notifying of breaches, matter 1
controls.statement: The organization has a process to tell the people and the authorities concerned of a breach in the time required.

controls.title: Notifying of breaches, matter 2
controls.statement: The process is practised.

controls.title: Accounting of disclosures, matter 1
controls.statement: The organization can give a person an account of the disclosures of their information.

controls.title: Accounting of disclosures, matter 2
controls.statement: The account is complete for the period asked.

controls.title: Quality of personal information, matter 1
controls.statement: Personal information is kept accurate, complete and relevant for the purposes it is used for.

controls.title: Quality of personal information, matter 2
controls.statement: The organization checks it at points where errors enter.

controls.title: Privacy monitoring and enforcement, matter 1
controls.statement: Complaints and questions about privacy are received, handled and answered.

controls.title: Privacy monitoring and enforcement, matter 2
controls.statement: Compliance with the privacy commitments is monitored and what is found is fixed.
